I have been reading about Theresa Greenfield on many major news platforms this week and was shocked to find her unlisted on Wikipedia. Here I added in several key pieces of information from the sources I was reading (with citations). I intend to come back to the article with more, but this is a start. It seems to me that if she has run twice now, she should be considered a notable political force in Iowa and someone to watch for the future of political developments in the state.
